chains.title: CEBPA-SORT1 hepatocyte enhancer

links.claim: CEBPA (HGNC:CEBPA) binds the alt T allele of rs12740374 more strongly than the ref G allele, creating/strengthening a C/EBP site; QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no QBiC-SELEX evidence is supplied. CEBPA is chosen as the hepatic C/EBP-family member from prior literature/expression context, not from QBiC-SELEX.
The rs12740374-containing sequence acts as a hepatocyte enhancer whose activity is higher on the alt T allele.
Higher enhancer activity increases SORT1 transcription.
This occurs in hepatocytes, consistent with the Hep 3B2.1-7 expression context.
Increased hepatic SORT1 lowers LDL cholesterol and myocardial infarction risk.

predictions: alt T allele binds CEBPA more strongly than ref G
alt T increases enhancer activity in hepatocytes
alt T increases SORT1 mRNA in hepatocytes
alt T lowers LDL cholesterol and MI risk
falsified_if: No allele-specific CEBPA binding at rs12740374
No SORT1 expression difference in hepatocytes
